escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. This week in the World, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over six hundred and fifty-six million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in the World. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Sunday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. At number ten, BullyJuice, with a video posted three days ago. Over twenty million views. A Short of just thirty-one seconds. It also has one hundred and forty-six comments.

Number nine, from Colombia, Mamá recetas2.0, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-one million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It also has over four thousand comments.
At number eight, from South Korea, DoubleBite, with “Water vs Dried Fish”. Over twenty-two million views. A Short of just fifty-nine seconds. It also has nine hundred and ninety-two comments.

Number seven, from India, JAI HIND OFFICIAL, with “Rakh Mein Mile Pairon Ke Nishan Aakhir Kiske The?”. Over twenty-two million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-five seconds.
Number six, from India, Facts' Mine, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-four million views. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds. It also has over two thousand comments.

Next up, number five, Deiva Divine, with a video posted six days ago. Over twenty-five million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and forty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.

Next up, number four, from United States, Ricks Clips, with “The Ancient Jar That Warned an Empire”. Over twenty-six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.

Bronze medal, Merry Latte, with “Comment STRAW if you NEED this!”. Over thirty-six million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-four thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifteen seconds.

Silver medal, from India, Shivapriya Official , with “Mango leaf decoration ideas for diwali”. Over forty-seven million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and ten thousand views per hour. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and thirty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week.
And finally, number one most viewed, from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with a video posted six days ago. Over eighty-two million views. It also has over three thousand comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Coming in at number ten, from Mexico, FedeGames, with a video posted five days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over six point four million views.

Coming in at number nine, from United States, Dream, with “Minecraft Speedrunner VS 6 Hunters FINALE”. Over twelve thousand comments. A video over forty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over ten million views.
Coming in at number eight, لانا و رورو, with a video posted two days ago. Over twelve thousand comments. It got there in just two days. It also has over six hundred and seventy-two thousand views.
At number seven, Mob Entertainment, with “What's the time?”. Over thirteen thousand comments. A Short of just forty-two seconds. It got there in just two days.

Number six, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a video posted three days ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: sixteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Coming in at number five, from United States, Mindova, with “Grandpa's Magic Made Millions Smile”. Over seventeen thousand comments. A Short of just sixteen seconds. It also has over sixteen million views.
At number four, Zack D. Films, with “Could You Move Mount Everest To America?”. Over twenty thousand comments. A Short of just sixty seconds. It also has over eighteen million views.
Bronze medal, from Indonesia, Dhot Design, with a video posted five days ago. Over twenty-three thousand comments. It also has over nine point three million views.

Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted two days ago. Over twenty-four thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about two hundred and thirty thousand views per hour. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from Brazil, Mundo Torajo, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirty-one thousand comments. It also has over six point eight million views.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. In position number ten, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted two days ago. Over four hundred and seventy-six thousand likes. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

At number nine, from United States, Conexwest, with a video posted three days ago. Over four hundred and eighty-one thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about eighty-three thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over sixteen million views.
In position number eight, Eyser, with a video posted six days ago. Over five hundred and eleven thousand likes. It also has over eleven million views.

In position number seven, from United States, Sean Andrew, with “I Tested the Famous Pirate Eye Patch Myth!”. Over five hundred and seventeen thousand likes. A Short of just forty-seven seconds. It also has over fourteen million views.
In position number six, from Colombia, Mamá recetas2.0, with a video posted five days ago. Over six hundred and eighty-one thousand likes. It also has over twenty-one million views.

In position number five, from India, Facts' Mine, with a video posted five days ago. Over six hundred and eighty-five thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds. It also has over twenty-four million views.

At number four, from Indonesia, isonkeh, with a video posted six days ago. Over seven hundred and thirty thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just thirty-three seconds.

Bronze medal, from United States, Ricks Clips, with “The Ancient Jar That Warned an Empire”. Over seven hundred and eighty-seven thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over twenty-six million views.
Silver medal, Zack D. Films, with “Why ChatGPT Contradicted Itself”. Over nine hundred and eight thousand likes. It also has over sixteen million views.

And finally, number one most liked, from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with a video posted six days ago. Over one million likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. It also has over eighty-two million views.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
